thesis: Sean Barrett argues that Toast is a category killer in the restaurant point-of-sale market with high-quality earnings, minimal customer churn, and a business model that has evolved from hyper-growth with negative margins to a durable compounder with 35% EBITDA margins. He contends that despite the broader market narrative of 'SaaS apocalypse,' Toast remains remarkably cheap at 18 times next year's earnings while continuing to grow gross profit by over 25% annually.
